description.value: Molly Tea is a Chinese jasmine tea beverage franchise originating from Shenzhen, built around high-quality floral teas scented with fresh flowers and inspired by the Four White Flowers of the East. The Richmond Union Square location offers a menu of fresh milk teas, snowy whipped cream drinks, oat milk teas, and floral fruit slushes, all centred on jasmine and other Eastern floral aromas. It is part of an expanding international chain with over 1,000 locations in China and growing presence across Canada, the US, UK, Australia, and Thailand.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mollyteaca.com is fully accessible and confirms an active Richmond Union Square location at '1323-8368 Capstan Wy, Richmond, BC', matching the OSM address tags exactly. The site presents a live menu and franchise listing with no indication of closure. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all such fields default to null.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website; phone field left null.
Website lists a contact email (promo@mollyteaca.com) that is a general franchise address, not store-specific.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bubble tea cafe confirmed active by website with a live menu and listed store location matching the OSM record.

Packed lunches.detail: Menu consists entirely of tea-based beverages; no food items mentioned
